source.text: ወእምድኅሬ*ዝ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ *ጻድቅ፡ ወኅሩይ፡ ቤተ፡ ምስትጉብኤ፡ ዚአሁ፡ እምይእዜ፡ ኢይትከልኡ፡ በስመ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: The selected text prints contracted ያስተርኢ and the longer expression ምስትጉብኤ, not the substituted synonym ማኅበሩ. Actual primary Dillmann1173 gives the corresponding longer noun family with congregatio as a sense; the selected inflected form is retained, not replaced by the dictionary head spelling. Assembly renders that noun family here. The causative appearance construction with accusative ቤተ is rendered make the house visible. The following negative verb is plural: they will not be hindered. No singular house-subject is substituted for that plural, and no historical identity of the righteous/chosen one or an unprinted group is supplied. The selected stars remain visible; these editorial constructions are not a new manuscript certification.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: Contracted appearance verb and longer congregation-family expression collated directly in actual135 PDF/native photographs. Dictionary headforms are lexical controls, not substitutes for selected fidels.
Singular righteous/chosen causative agent with accusative house; then plural negative they retained without inferred historical identity or added group. Printed stars retained.

translation.text: After this, the righteous and chosen one will make the house of his assembly visible. From now on they will not be hindered, in the name of the Lord of Spirits.[a]
